messages:
marta.mkt: Quick creative sprint request for next week's benchmark launch. Need a tightly scoped pack: 1 landscape hero (1200x628), 1 square mosaic tile (900x900), 1 compact "sparkline + callouts" SVG diagram (latency vs cost with 3 labeled levers), 1 one-column metric template for docs (600x800), and two email header sizes (600x200, 800x200). Can design do a 48hr turnaround?

dane.design: Sounds good. A couple Qs: do you want the mosaic tile to include micro-sparklines overlayed on the hero? Any mandatory icon style (line vs filled)?

riley.pm: Yes overlay sparklines on the mosaic would be great  they should show "before/after" optimization. Icon style: thin stroke icons to match our docs. Diagram needs to illustrate batching, KV cache, quantization as levers that shift the curve; keep it single-color-friendly for slide reuse.

lexi.content: Copy is ready. Two short headline options I'll drop in Figma comments: 
- "Serving smarter: lower cost, consistent latency"
- "Inference economics: batch, cache, quantize"
I'll also add 40-char social captions and 1-line alt text per frame.

dane.design: Nice. Deliverable specs I'll follow: landscape 1200x628, mosaic 900x900, metric 600x800, headers 600x200 + 800x200. Exports: SVG (diagram) with editable text layers, PNG@2x for tiles, and Figma components with tokenized colors. I'll add a dark-mode hero and a logo-free partner variant.

legal-bot: Flag: the trademarked phrase "Redwood Serving" requires sign-off. Avoid productized claims like "lowest cost". Use neutral/quantified language.

marta.mkt: Understood. We'll keep claims conservative; if legal blocks specific wording we can use: "Optimized inference for predictable latency and cost."

dane.design: Timeline: wireframes in 20h, prioritized comps (diagram + landscape hero) in 36h, full pack in 48h. Will post frames and tag reviewers.

figma-bot: File created by dane.design \u2014 6 frames added, comments enabled.

lexi.content: Tiny ask: include one alt-text line per exported asset in Figma comments so I can push to CMS immediately. Also please add a tiny PNG sprite with the three icons (batch, cache, quant) for docs usage.

dane.design: Will include icon sprite and usage note (1 paragraph) explaining when to use long vs mosaic vs metric template. Also adding a short CSS snippet for the sparkline overlay: ```css
.sparkline {
  stroke: var(--rw-accent-200);
  stroke-width: 2;
  fill: none;
}
```

riley.pm: Great. I'm scheduling a 15-min review after the prioritized comps are up. If legal requests wording changes, we'll swap to the fallback.

dane.design: Checklist: 1) SVG diagram (text vectors), 2) landscape hero (light/dark) + mosaic tile, 3) metric template + email headers, 4) logo-free partner variant, 5) PNG@2x + optimized SVGs, 6) icon sprite, 7) one-paragraph usage note, 8) alt-text in comments. Will update thread when frames are ready.

marta.mkt: Thanks team :thumbsup: tagging design owner in the calendar for the quick review slot.
